_comment: Mobile test sharding for @qvac/audiogen-ggml. The mobile CI action runs ONLY the tests listed here. Local `npm run ios/android` in qvac-test-addon-mobile extracts the async functions from test/mobile/test.cjs directly and does not consume this file. The generation tests and testLoadModels download the turbo-q4 ACE-Step GGUFs (~3 GB) from the registry on-device into <testDir>/models (a pre-side-loaded set there or in $AUDIOGEN_MODEL_DIR is used as-is). Android requires the full pipeline to run on Vulkan and produce non-silent audio; iOS keeps the CPU functional smoke.
